verdict.rationale: A recorded hands-on probe ran a fully non-interactive install end to end: `npx -y skills add anthropics/skills --skill skill-creator -a claude-code -y --copy` fetched the repo, installed one skill into ./.claude/skills/ and read it back, with no account needed. First-party docs back this up: a skill is just a SKILL.md directory that Claude picks up once placed on disk, skills can be uploaded via the Skills API, and the Agent SDK can load plugins programmatically. Missing for 10: a first-party documented headless install CLI (the probe used third-party `skills` tooling, and `/plugin install` is an in-session slash command), and explicit docs on unattended or no-prompt plugin installs.
